install: sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; for line in 'export RUSTUP_HOME="$HOME/.rustup"' 'export CARGO_HOME="$HOME/.cargo"' 'export VITASDK="$HOME/vitasdk"' 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$CARGO_HOME/bin:$VITASDK/bin:$PATH"'; do grep -qxF "$line" ~/.bashrc || echo "$line" >> ~/.bashrc; done; export RUSTUP_HOME="$HOME/.rustup" CARGO_HOME="$HOME/.cargo" VITASDK="$HOME/vitasdk" PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$HOME/vitasdk/bin:$PATH"; ./scripts/setup_env.sh --install-all && cargo fetch --locked
